terms.label: item
terms.note: a clear scopeable thing

terms.label: time
terms.note: passing

terms.label: comparison
terms.note: multi-item; the lens is inside it

terms.label: same
terms.note: two items identical in one comparison

terms.label: different
terms.note: two items not identical in one comparison

terms.label: change
terms.note: different of one item across time

terms.label: unchanged
terms.note: same of one item across time

terms.label: transformation
terms.note: change of what the item IS

terms.label: move
terms.note: change of WHERE the item is: a place, or a holder's hands

terms.label: actor
terms.note: item that is change driving

terms.label: non-actor
terms.note: item that drives no change; can still undergo change

terms.label: physicalness
terms.note: physical <-> virtual

terms.label: consumability
terms.note: consumable <-> non-consumable

terms.label: information
terms.note: item in form virtual x non-consumable

terms.label: structurality
terms.note: structured <-> unstructured: how much of the reading is built into the item's own form

terms.label: activity
terms.note: information about change: actor, action, object, target (the row)

terms.label: observation
terms.note: transforming, sub-category creation, of activity (the pen)

terms.label: rule
terms.note: information that is a requirement: should / should-not

terms.label: event
terms.note: activity of happened

terms.label: draft
terms.note: information an actor created that awaits a decision; status derived later

terms.label: decision
terms.note: activity that permanentises an information: changeable -> unchanged

terms.label: governance
terms.note: activity with a rule as object or target, by actors whose permission reaches rules

terms.label: compliance / breach
terms.note: same / different of an event and the rule it falls under

terms.label: judgment
terms.note: the transformation an actor performs on unstructured information to produce a reading

terms.label: S
terms.note: input and output both structured

terms.label: U
terms.note: input or output needs judgment

terms.label: U{s}
terms.note: structured input handed to a judgment (template with slots)

terms.label: S{u}
terms.note: a judgment's output caught in a structured shape (typed envelope)

terms.label: cell law
terms.note: every activity sits in exactly one cell, declared per operation

terms.label: actor class
terms.note: program drives S only; ai drives U; human both; system = the actor at the border

terms.label: ceiling
terms.note: a rule that only shrinks what a class may be granted

terms.label: relationship
terms.note: comparison of two items or two activities: part-of, standing beside, linked to, where in space

terms.label: geometry (Venn2)
terms.note: UR unrelated, AD touching, IN overlapping, NS inside at the edge, EM inside at the core; a row, never a stored graph

terms.label: frame
terms.note: the rule a relation was created under; composition holds only within one frame

terms.label: tree
terms.note: closure over NS/EM rows in one frame; never stored

terms.label: occupancy
terms.note: an AD relation instance between an actor and a place in a tree (the hat)

terms.label: authority
terms.note: a rule on roles plus two occupancies, computed; never a relation row

terms.label: rule content
terms.note: enforcement: scope x mechanism x source x strength; measurement: length x width x height

terms.label: environment change
terms.note: different between the world's events and the assumptions a rule was made under

terms.label: monitoring
terms.note: the record plus what is derived over it, at any moment

terms.label: analysis
terms.note: actors writing information rows about what the events show

terms.label: reporting
terms.note: a draft to change a rule, sent between actors

terms.label: announcement
terms.note: the event that a rule now exists; at digital speed the record's order is the announcement

terms.label: communication
terms.note: the rule restated in a more unstructured form for a human reader

terms.label: enforcement
terms.note: events brought to same with the rule: the gate refusing, or a breach row

terms.label: legitimacy
terms.note: sameness between what rules require and what their users accept

terms.label: metabolism
terms.note: intake of rules against retirement across time

terms.label: meta-rule
terms.note: a rule over the making of rules

terms.label: row
terms.note: one activity with its rule cited, its signature, its two times, the hash of the row before

terms.label: record
terms.note: every observation this body made, in one order, only ever added; the only definitive

terms.label: two times
terms.note: deciding time (legitimacy) + recording time (order); arrival never adjudicates

terms.label: gate
terms.note: the one actor that turns a draft into a decision row; the only pen

terms.label: operation
terms.note: a registered action shape: fields, checks, cell, rule cited; a definition row

terms.label: check
terms.note: a comparison the gate performs, from a closed vocabulary; an address: place x source x scope x combination

terms.label: polarity
terms.note: match-permission only: what no rule grants is refused

terms.label: founding / constitution
terms.note: the first rules, written before any event; never entered live

terms.label: tier
terms.note: constitutional + owner + ordinary; protection conserved: no gap, no demotion

terms.label: power
terms.note: the positive grant row; everything outside it the computed shadow

terms.label: space
terms.note: a containment tree of items; reach includes subspaces

terms.label: identity
terms.note: establishment row > session rows > occupancy rows; the view over them

terms.label: signature
terms.note: live identity from the channel transferred into the stored row

terms.label: key
terms.note: the bind row tying a secret to an actor; the key is a view over bind and revoke rows

terms.label: chain
terms.note: each row names the hash of the row before; a break is provable at a point

terms.label: attestation
terms.note: the body reads its own code whole and compares it to the digest in its record

terms.label: custody
terms.note: the view over move rows saying which actor last received an item; no delete, only handover

terms.label: blob
terms.note: content outside the row, addressed by hash; the row keeps the hash

terms.label: view
terms.note: information derived by comparison over the record; deleted and recomputed identical

terms.label: view tree
terms.note: four masters: events + rules + items + relationships; level 2 one split; level 3 S/U; level 4 computed

terms.label: stamp
terms.note: a master view's comparison of a draft as it climbs; detection never legitimacy

terms.label: loop
terms.note: a draft climbs through views that stamp it, the gate decides, the record broadcasts back

terms.label: program
terms.note: an actor established by a row; processes its incarnations; files its custody

terms.label: glass box
terms.note: every program has exactly two openings, to the user and to the system

terms.label: border
terms.note: the system as the one entity that cannot live behind a border; an outside request is a draft

terms.label: handshake
terms.note: who + what code + sane memory: three checks, mutual, graded admission

terms.label: one pen per record
terms.note: many records per body lawful; two pens on one record never

terms.label: institution
terms.note: a set of stage-role rows under one constitution; a tree of institutions; no gate above the boxes

terms.label: seam (twelve kinds of work)
terms.note: four object roots x six operations; the empty cells refusals by name

terms.label: body
terms.note: our own kernel: the performer beneath the seam, generated from the twelve rows, read whole and signed

terms.label: witness class
terms.note: witness-the-code (what hosts the gate) + witness-the-acts (every other entity)

terms.label: enclosure
terms.note: a borrowed worker run unmodified with its own declared served set; every crossing a row

terms.label: genesis
terms.note: the standing guardian of identity across every gap in consciousness

terms.label: wake checklist
terms.note: body, chain, constitution read back, views folded fresh, keys valid, account chain intact, then the first act

terms.label: genesis pair
terms.note: two bodies sharing no write path verify each other; a mutual receipt

terms.label: brake
terms.note: a frozen, negative-only view that answers before its row lands

terms.label: air
terms.note: the row as the smallest piece anyone can take without taking us
